Travelers use it to research destinations, compare accommodation options, and read firsthand accounts before booking, with AI-powered recommendations surfacing options relevant to their travel dates and preferences. It also functions as a booking platform for tours, activities, and some accommodation types.
name: Tripadvisor

description: Tripo3D generates textured 3D models from text or images in under 10 seconds, with a focus on speed and consistency suitable for real-time game assets and AR experiences. Its TripoSG model produces clean geometry and PBR textures ready for direct import into Unity, Unreal, and Blender. Studios prototyping 3D content and developers building AR features use it when turnaround time is the critical constraint.
name: Tripo3D

description: TruEra built tools for testing, monitoring, and explaining machine learning and LLM model quality, later acquired by Snowflake.
name: TruEra

description: TurboTax is a leading tax preparation platform that guides individuals and small business owners through filing federal and state tax returns with step-by-step questions and AI-powered guidance. It imports W-2s and 1099s by photo or direct connection to employers and financial institutions, reducing manual data entry and errors. Its AI tools identify deductions based on answers given throughout the interview and provide explanations for why specific tax rules apply to each user's situation.
name: TurboTax

description: Twilio provides the APIs that let developers add messaging, voice, and email into their own applications, and has layered AI on top for conversational customer engagement and support automation.
name: Twilio

description: Typeform is a form and survey builder that presents questions one at a time in a conversational style, resulting in higher completion rates than traditional forms. Marketing, research, and product teams use it for lead capture, customer feedback, NPS surveys, and quizzes. AI features help generate survey questions from a prompt and analyze open-text responses for common themes.
name: Typeform

description: Udemy is an open online learning marketplace with over 220,000 courses taught by independent instructors, covering everything from Python and UX design to guitar playing and yoga. Its AI personalises course recommendations and learning paths based on your career goals and past activity. Unlike subscription platforms, most courses are purchased individually — often at steep discounts — and owned permanently.
name: Udemy

description: Udio builds an AI music generation platform that turns text prompts into full songs, founded by former DeepMind researchers.
name: Udio

description: Uizard lets users generate UI mockups and prototypes from text prompts or hand-drawn sketches.
name: Uizard

description: Ultimate.ai builds AI agents that automate customer support resolution across chat, email, and social channels.
name: Ultimate.ai

description: Undermind is an AI research agent that conducts thorough academic literature searches far beyond what keyword search tools find. Given a research question, it recursively follows citation trails and semantic connections across scientific databases to surface the most relevant papers, even from unexpected disciplines.
name: Undermind

description: Unitree Robotics builds quadruped and humanoid robots, known for making advanced legged robots available at consumer-accessible prices.
name: Unitree Robotics

description: Unstructured builds tools that clean and structure unstructured documents like PDFs and slides so they can be used to feed LLM applications.
name: Unstructured

description: Upscayl is a free, open-source AI image upscaler for Linux, macOS, and Windows that processes images entirely on your GPU without sending data to any server. It uses Real-ESRGAN models to upscale photos, illustrations, and digital art by 2x to 16x with impressive quality, making it the go-to privacy-friendly upscaler.
name: Upscayl

description: Upstage is a Korean AI startup that builds the Solar family of efficient large language models, along with document AI tools, and has repeatedly topped open LLM leaderboards relative to its model size.
name: Upstage

description: Upstart builds an AI-based lending platform that assesses credit risk using data beyond traditional credit scores.
name: Upstart

description: V7 builds an annotation and workflow automation platform for training computer vision models, used heavily in healthcare and manufacturing.
name: V7

description: Vast.ai runs a marketplace where anyone can rent out spare GPU capacity for AI training and inference at competitive prices.
name: Vast.ai

description: Vectara builds a retrieval-augmented generation platform designed to reduce hallucinations in AI search and question answering.
name: Vectara

description: Vectorizer.ai uses AI to convert JPEG and PNG images to high-quality SVG vector graphics with clean paths and accurate colour reproduction. It is designed for designers who need scalable versions of logos, illustrations, or icons for print and web use, producing far cleaner results than traditional threshold-based vectorisers.
name: Vectorizer.ai

description: Vectra AI builds AI-powered threat detection software that identifies attacker behavior across networks, cloud, and identity systems.
name: Vectra AI

description: VEED.io is a browser-based video editor with powerful AI features including auto-subtitle generation, AI avatars for spokesperson videos, background removal, and noise cancellation. It requires no software installation and supports collaboration, making it popular with content creators, educators, and marketing teams.
name: VEED.io

description: Vellum builds tooling for prompt engineering, evaluation, and deployment aimed at teams shipping production LLM features.
name: Vellum

description: Vercel builds the Next.js web framework and a deployment platform for frontend apps, plus v0, a tool that generates UI code from prompts.
name: Vercel

description: Vianai Systems, founded by H2O.ai's creator, builds enterprise AI software focused on explainability and human oversight.
name: Vianai Systems

description: Vic.ai builds AI software that automates invoice processing and approval workflows for accounts payable teams.
name: Vic.ai

description: Vidyard builds a video hosting and sales enablement platform, with AI tools for generating and personalizing prospecting videos.
name: Vidyard

description: Vidyo.ai automatically converts long-form video content into engaging short clips optimised for LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels. Its AI identifies key moments, adds animated captions, and resizes the frame. Podcasters, educators, and marketers use it to multiply their reach with minimal effort.
name: Vidyo.ai

description: Visme is a visual content platform for creating presentations, infographics, reports, and social media graphics. Its AI Designer generates complete branded presentations from a prompt, while the AI Writer populates slides with relevant content. Marketing and communications teams use it as an alternative to Canva for data-heavy visuals.
name: Visme AI

description: Viz.ai builds AI software that analyzes medical scans to flag stroke and other time-critical conditions and alert care teams faster.
name: Viz.ai

description: vLex builds a global legal research platform with AI features for case law search and analysis across multiple countries.
name: vLex

description: Voiceflow builds a visual design tool for creating conversational AI agents that can be deployed as voice assistants or chatbots.
name: Voiceflow

description: Voicemod builds a real-time AI voice changer used by gamers and streamers for voice effects and character voices.
name: Voicemod

description: Voltage Park operates GPU data centers offering on-demand and reserved compute for AI training and inference workloads.
name: Voltage Park

description: Voyage AI builds text embedding and reranking models used for retrieval-augmented generation. It was acquired by MongoDB in 2025 to power native vector search in its database platform.
name: Voyage AI

description: Vyond is an AI-powered animated video creation platform that lets teams produce professional cartoon and character-based explainer videos without animation expertise. Its library of characters, scenes, and actions covers business, education, and healthcare scenarios, and an AI script-to-video feature generates a complete animated video from a script. Corporate L&D teams and marketing departments use Vyond to make training and communication content more engaging.
name: Vyond

description: Waifu2x is an open-source neural network-based image and video upscaler originally designed for anime-style artwork. It uses convolutional neural network models to intelligently enlarge images 2× while reducing compression artefacts and preserving clean edges. Despite its specialised origin, it works well on photographic content and remains a popular free option for basic AI upscaling tasks.
name: Waifu2x

description: Wanderlog is an AI trip planning app for building collaborative travel itineraries, discovering places, and optimizing routes. Travelers use it to import places from Google Maps, Instagram saves, and manual additions into a single organized trip plan, with the map view showing how stops relate geographically so they can sequence days logically. AI generates itinerary suggestions based on destination and trip length, and multiple travelers can edit the same trip together in real time.
name: Wanderlog

description: Warp builds a modern terminal application with an integrated AI assistant that explains commands and helps debug errors.
name: Warp

description: Watershed builds software that helps companies measure, report, and reduce their carbon emissions, with AI-assisted data collection.
name: Watershed

description: Wave.video is a video marketing platform that combines a video editor, live streaming, screen recorder, and video hosting. Its AI features include automatic video resizing for different platforms, auto-subtitles, and a text-to-video creator from blog posts. Marketers use it to repurpose content across every channel.
name: Wave.video

description: Waymo, an Alphabet subsidiary, builds self-driving technology and operates a robotaxi service in several U.S. cities.
name: Waymo

description: Wayve builds self-driving technology using end-to-end machine learning trained on real driving data, rather than hand-coded rules.
name: Wayve

description: Weaviate builds an open-source vector database used to power semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation applications.
name: Weaviate

description: Webflow builds a visual website design and CMS platform, with AI features for generating copy, layouts, and SEO content.
name: Webflow

description: Weights & Biases builds tooling for tracking, visualizing, and comparing machine learning experiments, widely used by AI research teams.
name: Weights & Biases

description: WellSaid Labs builds studio-quality AI voices for corporate training, marketing, and e-learning content.
name: WellSaid Labs

description: WeRide builds autonomous driving technology and operates robotaxi and robobus services across several Chinese cities.
name: WeRide

description: WHOOP is a wearable fitness tracker and performance coaching platform that continuously monitors heart rate variability, sleep, and physical strain to give athletes and active individuals a daily recovery score. Rather than counting steps or calories, it focuses on readiness by telling you how hard you can push based on how well you recovered. Coaches and athletes use the team dashboard feature to monitor recovery across rosters and identify when athletes are at elevated injury risk from accumulated strain.
name: Whoop

description: WhyLabs builds monitoring tools that detect data drift and quality issues in machine learning and LLM pipelines.
name: WhyLabs

description: Wix builds a widely used website builder platform, including an AI tool that generates a full site from a short business description.
name: Wix

description: Wiz builds a cloud security platform that maps and prioritizes risks across an organization's cloud environment, with AI used to analyze attack paths.
name: Wiz

description: Woebot is a mental health chatbot that delivers cognitive behavioral therapy techniques through short guided conversations. It is designed to be available any time, making CBT-based support accessible between therapy appointments or for people who are not currently working with a therapist. Clinical studies have shown reductions in depression and anxiety symptoms for users who engage with it regularly over a few weeks.
name: Woebot

description: Wolfram Alpha is a computational knowledge engine that answers factual queries by computing answers from structured data rather than retrieving web pages. Its AI integration with ChatGPT and native chat interface extends it to complex problem solving in maths, science, engineering, and finance.
name: Wolfram Alpha AI

description: Wonder Dynamics, acquired by Autodesk, builds AI tools that automatically animate and composite CGI characters into live-action footage.
name: Wonder Dynamics

description: Wordtune is an AI writing tool that rewrites sentences and paragraphs to be clearer, more concise, or more engaging, offering multiple alternative phrasings for any selected text. Its Spices feature adds supporting facts, examples, and counterarguments to help writers develop thin arguments. Over 10 million users use Wordtune daily to improve email drafts, reports, and academic writing without losing their own voice.
name: Wordtune

description: Workable is an all-in-one recruiting and HR platform that uses AI to source candidates, screen applications, and streamline the hiring process. Its AI Recruiter feature automatically suggests candidates from a database of 400 million+ profiles and helps evaluate applicants against job requirements.
name: Workable

description: Workday builds HR and finance management software and layers Illuminate, a set of generative AI features, across recruiting, payroll, and planning.
name: Workday

description: World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, researches AI models that understand and generate 3D physical spaces, sometimes called 'spatial intelligence.'

description: Writer builds a full-stack generative AI platform for enterprises, including its own models and tools for writing, workflow automation, and content governance.
name: Writer

description: Writesonic builds AI content generation tools for articles, ads, and product descriptions, along with an SEO-focused writing suite called Chatsonic.
name: Writesonic

description: Wysa is an AI mental health chatbot that provides emotional support through CBT, mindfulness exercises, and other evidence-based techniques in a private, text-based format. It is used by individuals managing anxiety, stress, and low mood, and is also deployed by employers and healthcare organizations as a mental health resource between clinical sessions. Its anonymized, conversational approach makes it more approachable for people who are reluctant to seek formal support.
name: Wysa

description: xAI is Elon Musk's AI company, best known for the Grok chatbot integrated into X (formerly Twitter). It focuses on models with real-time access to social media data.
name: xAI

description: XMind is a cross-platform mind mapping and brainstorming app with a wide variety of diagram styles including mind maps, fishbone diagrams, tree charts, and timelines. Students, product managers, and writers use it to organize ideas visually before writing or presenting, with templates that make it fast to start a new map from scratch. Its AI features can generate branch ideas, summarize existing maps, and help expand thinking when brainstorming runs dry.

description: XtalPi combines quantum physics, AI, and robotics to predict molecular properties for drug discovery and new materials development.
name: XtalPi

description: Yellow.ai builds a conversational AI platform for enterprise customer service and employee support automation across channels.

description: Yelp is the leading platform for local business discovery and crowd-sourced reviews in the US, covering restaurants, contractors, salons, and services. Its AI-powered search ranks results by relevance, distance, and review sentiment, and personalises recommendations based on your past activity. For local businesses, a strong Yelp presence directly influences consumer decision-making in their neighbourhood.

description: You.com builds an AI-powered search engine that combines web results with generative answers and custom AI agents.
name: You.com

description: Zapier builds a workflow automation platform connecting thousands of apps, with AI features for generating and customizing automations.

description: Zebra Medical Vision is an AI radiology platform that automatically analyzes medical imaging data to detect a broad range of conditions across CT, X-ray, and mammography studies. Radiologists and health systems use it to flag studies that may contain critical findings like pulmonary embolism, aortic aneurysm, or cancer so they can be prioritized for immediate review. Its algorithms have FDA clearance for multiple indications, and it is designed to run as a background layer within existing PACS and radiology workflows.

description: Zed Industries builds a high-performance, collaborative code editor with AI features built in from the ground up.
name: Zed Industries

description: Zendesk builds customer service software and has added AI agents and copilots that draft replies and resolve routine tickets automatically.
name: Zendesk

description: Zest AI builds machine learning models that help lenders make more accurate and fair credit underwriting decisions.
name: Zest AI

description: Zety is an AI-powered resume and cover letter builder with a large library of professionally designed templates and a real-time resume scorer. Its AI content analyser checks your resume against the requirements of your target role and suggests stronger action verbs, quantified achievements, and relevant skills. Job seekers use Zety to create multiple tailored application documents quickly during an active job search.
name: Zety

description: Zhipu AI, spun out of Tsinghua University research, builds the GLM family of language models and the ChatGLM assistant, and is one of China's leading foundation model startups.

description: ZipRecruiter is an AI-powered job marketplace that distributes job postings to 100+ job boards simultaneously and uses machine learning to identify the most qualified candidates from applicants. description: Zoho CRM is a feature-rich sales platform with an AI assistant called Zia that scores leads, predicts deal closure probability, detects anomalies in sales activity, and suggests the best time to contact each prospect. description: Algolia AI Search is an API-first search and retrieval platform combining semantic and keyword search, vector embeddings, relevance tuning, personalization, and ranking controls. Teams use it to build fast search, conversational discovery, and agent-driven experiences on their own content and product data.
name: Algolia AI Search
subtitle: API-first semantic and keyword search for AI experiences

description: AMD ROCm is an open software platform for building and deploying AI and high-performance computing workloads on AMD GPUs. It provides GPU drivers, compilers, libraries, and frameworks that let developers train and run machine learning models on AMD hardware.
name: AMD ROCm
subtitle: Open software platform for AI development and GPU computing

description: Baidu Qianfan is an enterprise AI development platform for accessing foundation models, building agents, and deploying model-powered applications. It offers ERNIE and other models through APIs alongside agent tooling, knowledge-base workflows, debugging, logging, and enterprise controls.
name: Baidu Qianfan
subtitle: Enterprise platform for building AI agents and model-powered apps

description: Braintrust is an AI observability and evaluation platform for tracing AI applications, measuring output quality, and catching regressions before release. Teams can inspect prompts and tool calls, run experiments on datasets, score outputs, and use quality gates to improve production AI systems.
name: Braintrust
subtitle: AI observability and evaluation platform for production systems

description: Cloudflare AI Gateway is a gateway for AI applications that provides analytics, logging, caching, rate limiting, retries, and model fallback across supported model providers. Developers can use it to observe usage and costs while adding resilience and controls to their AI requests.
name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
subtitle: AI application observability, controls, and multi-provider routing

description: Cohere North is an enterprise AI platform that lets organizations deploy AI agents connected to their people, data, and workplace tools. It is designed for business use cases that require enterprise controls and can help teams search information, automate work, and surface insights from internal systems.
name: Cohere North
subtitle: Enterprise AI agent platform for workplace productivity

description: Dataiku is an enterprise AI platform for preparing data, building AI applications and agents, governing deployments, and measuring business impact. Its visual and code-based tools help organizations develop and manage AI systems across teams and model providers.
name: Dataiku
subtitle: Enterprise platform for building, governing, and scaling AI

description: DeepSeek is the model family and API platform behind DeepSeek-V3 and the R1 reasoning line, released as open weights by the Chinese AI lab of the same name. R1 matches or beats several closed frontier models on math and coding benchmarks while costing a fraction to run, which is what got the rest of the industry paying attention. Because the weights are open, researchers and companies can self-host, fine-tune, or build on top of it instead of depending on a single vendor's API.
name: DeepSeek
subtitle: Open-weight reasoning models from the Chinese AI lab DeepSeek

description: DeepSeek Chat is DeepSeek's web-based AI assistant for answering questions, reasoning through problems, and helping with coding and writing. It provides conversational access to DeepSeek models through a consumer chat interface.
name: DeepSeek Chat
subtitle: AI assistant for reasoning, coding, and general questions

description: Elastic AI Assistant brings generative AI to Elastic search and security workflows. It helps teams investigate alerts, query and summarize data, and create context-aware responses using the information indexed in Elastic.
name: Elastic AI Assistant
subtitle: Generative AI assistant for search and security workflows

description: Figma Make is Figma's AI-driven prompt-to-app tool for turning a prompt or existing Figma designs into functional prototypes, interactive UI, and web apps. It combines AI chat with a visual canvas and code editor, so teams can iterate on generated experiences while retaining their design-system context.
name: Figma Make
subtitle: AI prompt-to-app builder for functional prototypes and web apps

description: FLUX is an image generation model built by Black Forest Labs, a team founded by former Stable Diffusion researchers. It's become the default open-weight option for people who want Midjourney-level image quality without depending on a closed API, with strong prompt adherence and noticeably better hands and text rendering than earlier open models. Developers self-host it, fine-tune it on custom styles, or run it through hosted endpoints on platforms like Replicate and Hugging Face.
name: FLUX
subtitle: Open-weight image generation model from Black Forest Labs

description: Gemini Pro is the mid-tier model in Google's Gemini lineup, sitting between the lightweight Flash models and the top-end Ultra tier. It was one of the first widely available models built natively for multimodal input rather than text-only with vision added later, and it still holds up well on tasks like reading charts, describing images in detail, and reasoning over mixed text-and-image documents. It's the version most developers reach for by default through the Gemini API when they need vision support without paying for the largest model.
name: Gemini Pro
subtitle: Google's mid-tier multimodal model, strong on vision tasks

description: GPT Image is OpenAI's image generation model, available in ChatGPT and through the API as gpt-image-1. Unlike the older DALL-E pipeline, it's built directly on the same transformer architecture as GPT-4o, which gives it much stronger prompt adherence, especially for text rendering inside images and multi-step edits described in plain language. Marketers, product teams, and developers use it to generate assets, mock up designs, and iterate on images conversationally rather than through separate prompt engineering.
name: GPT Image
subtitle: OpenAI's native image generation model built into ChatGPT and the API

description: Mistral is a French AI lab that builds both open-weight models (the Mistral and Mixtral series) and closed frontier models served through its Le Chat app and API. It's earned a reputation for squeezing strong performance out of smaller, cheaper-to-run models, which matters a lot for companies watching inference costs. It's also become the model of choice for European organisations that want strong AI capability from a company operating under EU data protection rules rather than a US or Chinese vendor.
name: Mistral
subtitle: Europe's leading AI lab, known for efficient open and closed models

description: NVIDIA NIM provides containerized, GPU-optimized inference microservices for deploying AI models. It packages models, runtimes, and optimized inference engines so developers can run generative AI services through standard APIs in cloud, data-center, and workstation environments.
name: NVIDIA NIM
subtitle: GPU-optimized inference microservices for deploying AI models

description: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for converting, optimizing, and deploying generative and conventional AI models across cloud, edge, and AI PC hardware. It supports common model frameworks and includes runtimes, model serving, and compression tools for efficient inference.
name: OpenVINO
subtitle: Open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference

description: Palantir AIP connects AI models to enterprise data and operational systems so organizations can build governed agents, workflows, and AI-powered applications. Its builder tools support production deployments with controls for security, auditing, and human review.
name: Palantir AIP
subtitle: Enterprise AI platform for operational agents and automations

description: Qualcomm AI Hub helps developers optimize, validate, profile, and deploy machine learning models on Qualcomm devices. It provides hardware-aware model conversion, cloud-hosted device testing, and a catalog of optimized models for on-device vision, audio, speech, and generative AI.
name: Qualcomm AI Hub
subtitle: On-device AI model optimization and deployment platform

description: Qwen Studio is Alibaba's AI assistant for chat, web search, document analysis, coding, and image and video generation. It uses the Qwen model family and supports multimodal inputs, long documents, and artifact-style creation in the conversation.
name: Qwen Studio
subtitle: Multimodal AI assistant powered by Qwen models

description: Sora is OpenAI's text-to-video generation model, first shown in early 2024 as a leap over anything else available at the time and later shipped as a standalone app. It could produce coherent, minute-long clips with consistent characters and camera movement from a single prompt, which was well ahead of most competitors on release. OpenAI has since folded video generation into its broader model lineup and is sunsetting Sora as a separate product through 2026, so new projects are better off building on whatever replaces it.
name: Sora
subtitle: OpenAI's video generation model, now being wound down in 2026

description: Stable Diffusion is Stability AI's open-source image generation model, and the one most responsible for kicking off the whole generative-image ecosystem back in 2022. Because the weights are freely available, it spawned an entire industry around it: fine-tuned checkpoints on Civitai, ControlNet for pose and composition control, and local tools like Automatic1111 and ComfyUI for running it on consumer GPUs. Newer models like FLUX now beat it on raw quality, but it's still the model most people learn image generation on, and the one with by far the largest library of community fine-tunes.
name: Stable Diffusion
subtitle: Stability AI's open-source text-to-image model

description: Tencent Cloud Agent Development Platform (ADP) is a platform for building enterprise AI agents with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, workflows, and multi-agent frameworks. It connects agents to organization-specific data and tools for deploying customized business assistants.
name: Tencent Cloud ADP
subtitle: Enterprise platform for building AI agents with RAG and workflows

description: Veo 2 was Google DeepMind's video generation model before Veo 3 replaced it, notable at launch for realistic physics and camera motion that held together better than most competing video models at the time. It lacked native audio generation, which Veo 3 later added, and Google has since moved most of its video features over to the newer model. It's kept here mainly for reference since some integrations and older workflows still point to it.
name: Veo 2
subtitle: Google DeepMind's earlier video model, now superseded by Veo 3

description: Veo 3 is Google DeepMind's video generation model, available through Gemini and Flow. Its standout feature over most competitors is native audio: it generates synchronized dialogue, sound effects, and ambient noise alongside the video itself instead of leaving the clip silent. It also holds up well on physics and motion consistency across longer shots, which is where a lot of earlier video models fell apart. Filmmakers and ad creators use it to produce short, near-broadcast-quality clips straight from a text prompt.
name: Veo 3
subtitle: Google DeepMind's video generation model with native audio

description: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source automatic speech recognition model, trained on a large enough mix of multilingual audio that it handles accents, background noise, and technical vocabulary noticeably better than the transcription tools that came before it. Because it's free to download and run locally, it's become the engine underneath a huge number of transcription apps and meeting-notes tools rather than something people use directly. Developers who need transcription baked into their own product default to it before looking at paid APIs.
name: Whisper
subtitle: OpenAI's open-source speech-to-text model

description: Aixploria is one of the longer-running AI tools directories, tracking thousands of tools across dozens of categories from writing to 3D generation. It ranks entries by popularity and lets visitors browse by free, freemium, or paid pricing, plus a 'no login required' filter for quick testing. The site publishes in several languages and adds new tools on a near-daily basis.
name: Aixploria
subtitle: Long-running AI tools directory with thousands of listings

description: AllThingsAI catalogues AI tools by category and leans on comparison pages that pit two or three similar products against each other on price, features, and reviews. This makes it useful for narrowing down between close competitors rather than just browsing a long list. It also tracks AI news and maintains a glossary for people newer to the space.
name: AllThingsAI
subtitle: AI tools directory with side-by-side comparison pages

description: Born to Found is an AI coaching platform built around six startup stages, from idea to scalable company. It pairs stage-specific playbooks and checklists with an AI coach that answers questions and gives feedback based on the founder's business type, whether that's a SaaS product, newsletter, marketplace, agency, or mobile app. Founders get a tool directory matched to whatever stage they are actually in, instead of a generic list of startup advice.
name: Born to Found
subtitle: AI coaching platform that guides founders through six startup stages

description: Dang.ai runs like a Product Hunt spinoff dedicated entirely to AI: makers submit tools for community upvotes, and the homepage surfaces whatever is trending that week. Categories cover the usual writing, image, and coding tools, plus a running feed of the newest submissions. It doubles as a launch platform, with a paid option for makers who want faster review and a featured spot.
name: Dang.ai
subtitle: Product Hunt-style directory for launching and discovering AI tools

description: Future Tools is a hand-curated directory of AI tools built by content creator Matt Wolfe, who screens every submission before it's listed. Entries are grouped by category (writing, video, productivity, and more) with a 'most saved' and 'newest' view, plus a running news feed of AI developments tied to his YouTube channel. It skips the noise of auto-scraped directories in favour of a smaller, vetted list.
name: Future Tools
subtitle: Hand-curated AI tools directory with YouTube coverage

description: Futurepedia catalogues thousands of AI tools organised by category and business use case, aimed at professionals and teams looking to adopt AI in their workflow. Listings include pricing, feature summaries, and user reviews, alongside curated collections like 'best AI tools for marketing' or 'for video'. It also runs an AI tool report and newsletter covering weekly launches.
name: Futurepedia
subtitle: Business-focused directory of AI tools by use case

description: Insidr.ai pairs its AI tools directory with practical how-to content, walking through specific workflows like automating research or building a marketing funnel with AI. Listings are grouped by use case rather than raw category, aimed at people who want an outcome, not just a tool name. A weekly newsletter rounds up new tools and prompts alongside the directory.
name: Insidr.ai
subtitle: AI tools directory paired with tutorials and workflow guides

description: There's An AI For That (TAAFT) is one of the largest AI tools directories on the web, letting people search by the task they want done rather than by category alone. It tracks tens of thousands of tools, ranks them by daily traffic and saves, and publishes a regular newsletter covering new launches. A dedicated GPT and API section covers ChatGPT plugins and OpenAI-based tools specifically.
name: There's An AI For That
subtitle: Largest AI tools directory, searchable by task

description: Toolify.ai lists tens of thousands of AI tools across categories such as chatbots, image generation, and coding, ranking each by estimated monthly traffic and revenue where available. It surfaces trending and newly launched tools daily and includes a comparison view for evaluating similar products side by side. Multi-language support makes it popular outside English-speaking markets as well.
name: Toolify.ai
subtitle: Large-scale AI tools directory with traffic-based rankings

description: TopAI.tools organises its listings around community upvotes rather than paid placement, giving smaller tools a way to surface alongside established names. Each entry includes pricing, a short pitch, and tags, and users can filter by category or sort by newest, trending, or most upvoted. It also runs a 'launch' feature letting makers submit new tools for community feedback.
name: TopAI.tools
subtitle: AI tools directory ranked by community upvotes

description: Nano Banana Pro is Google's image generation model, available through Gemini and the Google AI tooling. Its main selling points are speed and detail: it renders 4K images in under ten seconds and does well on photorealism and legible text, two areas that used to force a trade-off. It fits workflows where people iterate quickly on a lot of variations, such as social posts, ad creative, and thumbnail testing, and want each pass to come back fast enough to keep the momentum going.
name: Nano Banana Pro
subtitle: Google's fast image model for 4K photorealistic images

description: Best of AI is a curated, open source directory of AI tools. Every listing is a Markdown file in a public GitHub repo — browse by category or profession, filter by price, search, or check the leaderboard for top-ranked picks. Free to browse; full index at /index.json.
name: Best of AI
subtitle: Open source directory of handpicked, ranked AI tools

description: AI for Developers is a Substack newsletter aimed at software developers who want to bring AI into their daily work, with practical tutorials, tool comparisons, and hands-on examples rather than high-level commentary. Each issue focuses on something a developer can act on directly, from integrating LLM APIs to using AI tools inside the editor to automating repetitive engineering tasks. It is written for people who already know how to code and want to understand what AI can do for them specifically.
name: AI for Developers
subtitle: Practical AI for software developers

description: The Altern Newsletter is a weekly roundup of new AI tools, resources, and community finds curated by the Altern team. It covers recently launched tools across categories including writing, coding, image generation, and productivity, with short descriptions and direct links. A low-noise option for staying aware of what is shipping without wading through announcements yourself.
name: Altern Newsletter
subtitle: Weekly AI tools and discoveries, curated by the Altern team

description: Superhuman AI is Zain Kahn's newsletter on using AI practically, covering tool reviews, workflow ideas, and tactics for getting more out of the AI products you already have access to. It focuses on the application layer rather than research news, making it useful for professionals who want to integrate AI into their work rather than just stay informed about industry developments. Issues typically include a main feature on a specific use case plus a curated digest of notable AI tools and updates from the week.
name: Superhuman AI
subtitle: Use AI to get more done

description: A live market-context graph for AI agents: real-time order flow, dealer gamma, institutional holdings, insider and political trades, SEC filings, and executive sentiment, all connected and queryable so agents reason from grounded primary data, not stale training.
name: SwiftAlerts

description: The Neuron is a daily newsletter covering new AI models, tools, and research in plain language without hype. It goes out every weekday and covers what actually matters across labs and products, with short summaries that take a few minutes to read. A good starting point if you want to stay current without spending hours on AI Twitter.
name: The Neuron
subtitle: Daily AI news in plain language

description: The Rundown AI is a daily email newsletter covering the most important AI news and developments in short, focused summaries without padding or filler. It is read by hundreds of thousands of subscribers who want to stay current on AI research, tools, and industry moves without spending hours across multiple sources. Each issue covers new model releases, product launches, funding announcements, and notable research papers in a format you can get through in a few minutes.
name: The Rundown AI
subtitle: Daily AI news, short and to the point

description: AICode is a coding assistant built for large, complex legacy codebases rather than fresh projects. It understands multi-file dependencies and systems where context spans hundreds of files, helping developers navigate, refactor, and add features without breaking existing behavior. The focus is on enterprise teams working on mature software with years of decisions baked in.
name: AICode

description: Anomaly AI is a data analysis workspace built for large spreadsheets and business datasets. Non-technical users can ask questions in plain English and get instant charts, trend analysis, and anomaly detection across millions of rows. Finance, operations, and sales teams use it instead of writing SQL or Python.
name: Anomaly AI

description: All-in-one AI image editor with infinite canvas, agents, specific for e-commerce sellers with 20+ tools. From background to product editing, thousands of prompts with all sorts of presets, ready to use for Shopify, Amazon sellers.
name: Igly

description: QuillBotAI Pro is a free, unlimited AI content detector that identifies text generated by ChatGPT, GPT-5, Gemini, Claude, and Llama, including output that has been humanized or paraphrased to evade simpler detectors. Educators and publishers use it to check submitted work and articles for AI-generated content without a subscription or account, with sentence-level heatmap analysis showing exactly which passages are flagged rather than returning a single document-wide score. No signup is required, making it fast to use for one-off checks.
name: QuillBotAI Pro — Free AI Content Detector for Educators & Publishers

description: Submit AI Tools is a directory for discovering and evaluating AI tools, chatbots, and content generation apps across dozens of categories. Users browse or search the catalog to find tools for specific tasks, compare options in a category, and submit new tools for listing. It serves as a reference point for people tracking the AI tool landscape who want a structured index rather than relying on social media recommendations or search results.
name: Submit AI Tools

description: ZOOOP is an AI-native creative platform for generating images, video, and audio on an infinite canvas with team collaboration and AI agent access. Creators use it without a subscription model — purchased credits never expire, removing the pressure to use the platform every month. It supports multi-modal generation in a single workspace so teams can move between image, video, and audio tasks without switching tools, with agent-based workflows for more complex creative pipelines.
name: ZOOOP

description: AgentOps is an observability platform for AI agents that records session replays, tracks token costs, and surfaces errors across agent runs. Developers building multi-agent systems use it to understand why an agent failed, how long each step took, and how much a session cost. It integrates with frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, and AutoGen through a simple SDK.
name: AgentOps

description: AIPRM is a prompt management platform with a large community-curated library of prompts for SEO, marketing, coding, and other use cases. It runs as a Chrome extension that adds a prompt browser directly inside ChatGPT, so users can search and run proven prompts without copying and pasting. Teams can also save private prompt collections and share them across an organization.
name: AIPRM

description: Alli AI pushes on-page SEO optimizations directly to live websites at scale, without manual developer deployments. Teams use it to run title tag, meta description, and schema changes across thousands of pages from a single dashboard. It connects via a JavaScript snippet and applies changes in real time, bypassing the usual content management bottleneck.
name: Alli AI

description: Amplemarket automates outreach, lead research, and pipeline generation for B2B sales teams. It enriches prospect data, writes personalized email sequences, and tracks engagement signals to prioritize follow-up. Teams use it to cut the manual work of building and working a pipeline so reps spend more time in actual conversations.
name: Amplemarket

description: Anyscale is a managed platform for building, fine-tuning, and serving AI models at scale, built on the Ray distributed computing framework. ML teams use it to run large training jobs and serve inference workloads without managing cluster infrastructure. It also provides a hosted API for running open-source models like Llama and Mistral in production.
name: Anyscale

description: Arcade turns screen recordings into guided, clickable product walkthroughs. Marketing and sales teams use it to build demos that prospects can explore on their own, without scheduling a live call or setting up a sandbox. Demos embed in websites, emails, or share as a direct link.
name: Arcade

description: Baseten is a model inference infrastructure platform for deploying AI models in production with fast cold start times. ML teams use it to serve custom models, fine-tuned checkpoints, and open-source models like Llama through a simple API without managing GPU clusters. It handles autoscaling and caching so models stay responsive under variable traffic without unnecessary compute costs.
name: Baseten

description: BentoML is an open-source framework for packaging and deploying machine learning models at production scale. ML engineers wrap any model from any framework into a standardized service, then ship it as a Docker container or push it to cloud platforms. Batching, async serving, and multi-model pipelines are handled out of the box.
name: BentoML

description: Bloomfire centralizes company knowledge into a searchable hub. Teams use it to cut down on repeated questions by surfacing answers from documentation, past support tickets, and internal wikis through natural language search. It fits customer support, sales enablement, and onboarding workflows well.
name: Bloomfire

description: C3.ai provides a suite of enterprise AI applications for industries like energy, manufacturing, financial services, and government. Organizations use it to deploy pre-built AI applications for predictive maintenance, fraud detection, and inventory optimization, or to build custom AI solutions on the C3 AI platform. It is designed for large enterprises with complex data environments and regulatory requirements.
name: C3.ai

description: Cal.com is an open-source scheduling platform with an AI assistant that handles meeting booking and calendar coordination. Teams and individuals use it to share booking links, set availability rules, and let the AI negotiate scheduling across time zones. It can be self-hosted for organizations that need full control over their scheduling data.
name: Cal.com

description: ChurnZero is a customer success platform for SaaS companies that uses AI to predict churn, score account health, and automate engagement tasks. Customer success teams use it to track product usage alongside support and CRM data, trigger playbooks when accounts show warning signs, and surface which customers are candidates for expansion. It integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, and major CRM systems.
name: ChurnZero

description: Cognism is a B2B sales intelligence platform that provides verified contact data alongside buying intent signals for prospecting. Sales teams use it to find decision-makers at target accounts, filter by intent data to prioritize outreach, and get phone-verified mobile numbers that connect more reliably than email alone. It is particularly strong for prospecting in the UK and European markets.
name: Cognism

description: ConvertKit is an email marketing platform built for creators including writers, podcasters, and course sellers. It handles subscriber management, automated email sequences, and a commerce layer for selling digital products directly to your list. AI writing tools help draft newsletters and subject lines, and the free plan covers up to 10,000 subscribers.
name: ConvertKit

description: Cutout.Pro is an AI image editing platform for background removal, photo retouching, and visual enhancement. Designers and e-commerce teams use it to batch-process product images and clean up visuals without desktop software. It handles complex edges like hair and fur well, and processes images through a web upload or API.
name: Cutout.Pro

description: Databricks is a unified data and AI platform built on lakehouse architecture that combines data engineering, analytics, and machine learning in one environment. Data engineering and ML teams use it to process large datasets with Apache Spark, train and fine-tune models, and deploy them to production, all without moving data between separate systems. It supports Delta Lake for reliable data storage and integrates with cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
name: Databricks

description: DataStax is a data platform built around Astra DB, a managed vector database for building real-time AI applications. Development teams use it to store and query vector embeddings at scale for RAG pipelines, recommendation systems, and semantic search. It is based on Apache Cassandra and built to handle high-throughput, low-latency workloads that most relational databases struggle with at scale.
name: DataStax

description: DeepInfra is a cloud inference platform for running open-source AI models through a simple API without managing GPU infrastructure. Developers use it to call models like Llama, Mistral, and Whisper at low cost, with pricing based on tokens consumed rather than reserved compute. It is a practical option for teams that want access to frontier open-source models without building their own serving stack.
name: DeepInfra

description: Eden AI is a unified API gateway that provides access to AI models from multiple providers including OpenAI, Google, AWS, and others through a single standardized interface. Developers use it to compare outputs across providers for tasks like OCR, translation, speech recognition, and text generation, then switch between them without changing their integration. It simplifies vendor comparison and reduces the effort of managing multiple AI API subscriptions.
name: Eden AI

description: Enhancv is a resume builder that helps job seekers write stronger resumes using AI suggestions grounded in real hiring data. It offers templates that format well in ATS systems and prompts users to add quantifiable achievements rather than generic job duties. The AI coach reviews each section and flags weak phrasing before the resume goes out.
name: Enhancv

description: Firecrawl is a web scraping API that crawls entire websites and converts their content into clean markdown formatted for use in AI applications and LLM context windows. Developers use it to feed web content into RAG pipelines, research agents, and data extraction workflows without building their own crawler or handling JavaScript rendering. It handles dynamic sites, authentication, and rate limiting so scraped content arrives clean and structured.
name: Firecrawl

description: Gainsight is a customer success platform that uses AI to score account health, flag churn risk, and identify expansion opportunities. Customer success teams use it to manage their entire portfolio from a single view, triggering automated playbooks when accounts show early warning signs. It connects to CRM, product usage data, and support tickets to build a complete picture of each customer.
name: Gainsight

description: Gencraft is an AI image and video generation app for creating art, avatars, and creative content on mobile and web. Creators use it to generate images from text prompts, transform photos with artistic styles, and produce short AI videos without any design experience. Its mobile-first design makes it accessible for social media content creation, and the app includes a feed for discovering and remixing what other users have made.
name: Gencraft

description: Genmo is an AI video generation platform and the team behind Mochi 1, an open-source video generation model known for high-motion clips and fluid character movement. Researchers and creators can run Mochi 1 locally from the open-source weights, or use Genmo's consumer app to generate videos from text prompts without any setup. It is one of the more technically capable open-source video models available.
name: Genmo

description: GetResponse is an email marketing and automation platform that covers email campaigns, landing pages, webinars, and list building in one tool. Small businesses use it to build automated email sequences, run paid newsletter programs, and create opt-in pages without needing separate software for each function. An AI email generator helps write campaign copy and subject lines.
name: GetResponse

description: Glassbox is a digital experience analytics platform that records session replays and generates heatmaps to show how users actually behave on websites and apps. Product and UX teams use it to find where customers drop off, struggle, or encounter errors, then prioritize fixes based on real usage data. AI surfaces patterns across thousands of sessions so analysts do not need to watch recordings manually.
name: Glassbox

description: Haystack is an open-source Python framework by deepset for building NLP and RAG pipelines in production. Developers use it to connect retrieval systems, language models, and data sources into end-to-end search and question-answering applications. It has a large library of pre-built components for document stores, embedders, and generators.
name: Haystack

description: Hex is a collaborative data workspace where analysts and data scientists work on notebooks, dashboards, and data apps in a shared environment. Teams use it for exploratory analysis and building internal tools that non-technical stakeholders can interact with. Its AI features help write SQL, debug code, and generate chart configurations from natural language prompts.
name: Hex

description: Higgsfield AI is a video generation platform that gives users more control over generated footage than most competitors. You specify camera movements, character behavior, and cinematic style rather than hoping a prompt lands right. Content creators who need consistent output across a series of clips tend to find it more predictable than prompt-only tools.
name: Higgsfield AI

description: Highspot gives revenue teams a single place to manage content, train reps, and guide them through complex sales motions. Managers can ensure reps find the right asset at each deal stage, while analytics show which content actually moves pipeline. It integrates with Salesforce, Teams, and most major CRM systems.
name: Highspot

description: Hocoos is an AI website builder that creates complete, publish-ready websites in minutes by asking a few questions about your business. Small business owners use it to get a professional website with generated copy, images, and structure without design or coding skills. The result includes hosting, a domain, and built-in tools for booking, e-commerce, and contact forms.
name: Hocoos

description: Hour One turns scripts into professional presenter-led videos using realistic virtual human avatars. L&D teams, marketers, and content creators use it to produce training videos, product explainers, and marketing content without cameras, studios, or actors. You pick an avatar, paste in a script, and the platform generates a finished video in minutes.
name: Hour One

description: Huntr is a job search tracker that organizes your applications into a Kanban-style board with stages from wishlist to offer. Job seekers use it to keep track of where they applied, upcoming interviews, and follow-ups without losing details across email threads. AI tools help tailor resumes and cover letters to specific job descriptions, and the chrome extension captures job listings from any site.
name: Huntr

description: Instapage is a landing page platform for building, A/B testing, and personalizing post-click experiences for paid campaigns. Marketing teams can create dedicated pages without developer help, then improve performance through built-in experimentation and heatmap analytics. It connects to Google Ads, Meta, and most major ad platforms.
name: Instapage

description: Jobscan compares your resume against a specific job description and scores how well they match for applicant tracking systems. Job seekers use it to identify missing keywords and skills before applying, increasing the chance their resume gets past automated screening. It also scans LinkedIn profiles and cover letters for the same kind of keyword gap analysis.
name: Jobscan

description: Kaspr is a LinkedIn prospecting tool that instantly surfaces verified phone numbers and email addresses for contacts you find on the platform. Sales teams use its Chrome extension to pull contact details from LinkedIn profiles and Sales Navigator without leaving the browser. Credits refresh monthly, and data enrichment can be pushed directly to HubSpot, Salesforce, and other CRMs.
name: Kaspr

description: Keyword Insights is an AI keyword research and content clustering tool that groups keywords by search intent and topic to help sites build topical authority. SEO teams use it to plan content calendars around clusters of related terms rather than targeting individual keywords in isolation. It also generates content briefs and identifies which existing pages should be consolidated or expanded.
name: Keyword Insights

description: Kommunicate is an AI chatbot and live chat platform for automating customer support with smooth human handoff when conversations get complex. Support teams use it to build no-code chatbots that handle common queries, then pass unresolved tickets to human agents with full conversation history intact. It integrates with Dialogflow, OpenAI, and most help desk systems.
name: Kommunicate

description: Landbot is a no-code chatbot builder for creating conversational flows on websites, WhatsApp, and landing pages. Marketing and customer success teams use it to collect leads, qualify visitors, and route inquiries through interactive conversation trees without writing code. It handles conditional logic, CRM integrations, and handoff to live agents when a conversation needs a human.
name: Landbot

description: Laxis is an AI meeting assistant that transcribes, summarizes, and extracts insights from sales calls, interviews, and client meetings. Sales and research teams use it to capture what was discussed without taking manual notes, and to pull out action items, objections, and key quotes automatically after each call. It connects to Zoom, Google Meet, and major CRMs so meeting outputs land directly in the tools teams already use.
name: Laxis

description: Let's Enhance is an AI image upscaling tool that increases photo resolution up to 16x while preserving and sharpening detail. Photographers, e-commerce teams, and print designers use it to enlarge low-resolution images without the blurring that comes from traditional interpolation. It also fixes JPEG artifacts and improves image quality in a single processing step.
name: Let's Enhance

description: Letta is an open-source framework for building stateful AI agents that maintain long-term memory and use external tools across extended conversations. Developers use it to create agents that remember user preferences, track ongoing tasks, and take actions through tool integrations rather than just generating text. It is built for applications where a single conversation session is not enough context.
name: Letta

description: Lifesum is a nutrition and diet tracking app that provides personalized meal plans, calorie logging, and macronutrient tracking. Users log meals by searching a food database or scanning barcodes, and the app adjusts recommendations based on goals like weight loss, muscle gain, or balanced eating. It pairs with Apple Health and fitness trackers to account for calories burned alongside those consumed.
name: Lifesum

description: Lindy is a no-code platform for building AI assistants and automations that work across the tools you already use. Teams build Lindies that handle tasks like triaging emails, scheduling meetings, researching leads, and summarizing documents, then connect them to Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, and dozens of other services through built-in integrations. It is designed for non-technical users who want AI automation without writing code or managing prompts directly.
name: Lindy

description: Lusha is a B2B sales intelligence tool for finding verified phone numbers, email addresses, and company data for prospect lists. Sales reps use its browser extension to pull contact details directly from LinkedIn profiles, while the API supports bulk prospecting and CRM enrichment workflows. Data is sourced from a mix of public records and a community-driven user network.
name: Lusha

description: Magic Patterns generates React component prototypes from text descriptions. Frontend developers and product designers use it to scaffold UI components quickly in their existing design system style, then copy the code directly into their codebase. It outputs working React and Tailwind code rather than just screenshots or static mockups.
name: Magic Patterns

description: Magnific AI upscales and enhances images by generating new photorealistic detail rather than just interpolating pixels. Photographers, digital artists, and creative directors use it to enlarge images without the blurring typical of traditional upscaling. The level of added detail is adjustable, making it useful for anything from subtle clean-ups to heavy creative reinterpretations.
name: Magnific AI

description: Mailchimp is an email marketing platform for building campaigns, automating email sequences, and tracking audience performance. It uses AI to suggest send times, generate subject lines, and draft email copy. Small businesses and creators use it as an all-in-one tool for email marketing, landing pages, and basic audience management.
name: Mailchimp

description: MailerLite is an email marketing platform for creating campaigns, building automations, and publishing landing pages and newsletters. Small businesses and creators use it for its generous free plan, which covers up to 1,000 subscribers with most core features included. AI writing assistance helps draft email copy and subject lines, and A/B testing is available on paid plans.
name: MailerLite

description: ManyChat automates customer interactions on Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and SMS. Brands and creators use it to capture leads, run promotions, answer common questions, and walk users through purchase flows with chat sequences triggered by keywords or actions. No coding required; it connects to Shopify, Klaviyo, and other e-commerce tools.
name: ManyChat

description: Marketinguys is a discovery platform for finding, comparing, and connecting with marketing professionals and creative agencies. Users can browse marketer profiles, explore agency specialties, and submit their own profile to join the directory. Built for teams hiring marketing talent or agencies for their next campaign.
name: Marketinguys
subtitle: Discover and connect with top marketers and creative agencies

description: memoQ is a computer-assisted translation tool and translation management system used by professional translators, language service providers, and in-house localization teams. It combines translation memory, terminology management, and AI-assisted suggestions to speed up repetitive work without losing consistency. It handles XLIFF, DOCX, HTML, software strings, and other complex formats natively.
name: memoQ

description: Minimax is a Chinese AI company that offers video generation, image generation, and multimodal foundation models through a consumer app and developer APIs. Its Hailuo video model competes with tools like Kling and Sora for text-to-video generation, producing high-motion, photorealistic clips. Models are available to developers internationally through the Minimax API.
name: Minimax

description: MLflow is an open-source platform for managing the machine learning lifecycle from experiment tracking to production deployment. Data scientists use it to log runs, compare parameters and metrics across experiments, and package models in a reproducible format. It works with any ML framework and integrates with Databricks, SageMaker, and most cloud ML platforms.
name: MLflow

description: Moonvalley is a video generation platform for creating cinematic-quality clips from text prompts and reference images. Filmmakers and creative studios use it for concept visualization, pre-production storyboarding, and generating footage that would be expensive to shoot. The platform focuses on output quality and creative control rather than raw generation speed.
name: Moonvalley

description: MotherDuck is a serverless analytics platform built on DuckDB that lets analysts run fast SQL queries against local files and cloud storage without managing infrastructure. It extends DuckDB with cloud storage, collaboration, and sharing so teams can work on the same data without moving it into a traditional data warehouse. An AI assistant lets users query data using natural language for analysts who are less comfortable writing SQL.
name: MotherDuck

description: Movio creates spokesperson videos from scripts using realistic digital avatars, without cameras or actors. Marketing teams, e-learning creators, and businesses use it to produce training videos, product explainers, and sales content at scale. You write the script, pick an avatar, and the platform generates a lip-synced video in the language and tone you need.
name: Movio

description: Navattic is an interactive demo platform for building no-code product tours that marketing teams embed on websites and landing pages. Prospects can click through a guided walkthrough of the actual product interface before ever signing up. description: Casetext is a legal AI company founded in 2013, backed by Y Combinator and Union Square Ventures. CoCounsel, its GPT-4-powered assistant launched in March 2023, is where that decade of work landed. CoCounsel drafts legal research memos, reviews and summarizes documents, builds deposition prep packages from discovery files, and analyzes contracts for missing clauses and risk terms. It covers both litigation and transactional work, which is less common than it sounds; most legal AI tools pick a lane. The deposition prep feature in particular is the kind of thing that previously took a junior associate a full day. Before launch, Casetext's Trust Team put CoCounsel through more than 30,000 legal questions, logging close to 4,000 hours of fine-tuning. The company had received early access to GPT-4 from OpenAI, and that head start showed. The product launched already shaped around real legal tasks rather than retrofitted from general chat. Thomson Reuters acquired Casetext in August 2023 for $650 million cash. The company had over 10,000 law firm and corporate legal department customers at the time. CoCounsel is now part of the Thomson Reuters product line, sitting alongside Westlaw and Practical Law.

description: Fashwell is a Swiss computer vision company, founded in 2014, that builds image recognition tools for fashion and home and living retail. The core product is a visual search engine: a shopper uploads any photo, a screenshot, a street style shot, a picture from a magazine, and gets matched to shoppable products in the retailer's catalogue. About 30% of text-based fashion searches return nothing useful, because people often know what they want visually but can't put it into words. Visual search sidesteps that entirely. The API covers more ground than search alone. It handles similar product recommendations, outfit completion (feed it a model image and it identifies every item she is wearing, ready to add to the page for purchase), and automatic catalogue tagging for colour, style, occasion, and garment type. There is also aesthetic profiling, which classifies a shopper's broader taste, "bohemian," "heritage," and so on, to personalise what they see across sessions. Clients include Zalando, Nelly.com, and Bonprix. Fashwell puts its recommendation engine's engagement lift at up to 250% and conversion improvement at 35%. Visual search, according to the company, runs 8x faster than keyword-based alternatives. Retailers don't send customers to a separate Fashwell interface; everything integrates into their own apps and storefronts via the API.

subtitle: Visual search and AI product tagging for fashion retail

description: Hatchful is Shopify's free logo maker. No subscription, no watermarks, no paid upgrade to unlock the good stuff. Anyone can use it, download the files, and walk away without entering a credit card. The whole thing takes under five minutes. You pick where the logo will be used (online store, social media, print), choose an industry, select a handful of style directions like bold, minimalistic, or hipster, type in your business name and an optional slogan, and then browse generated options. Hatchful has over 13,000 design combinations across 17 style categories. Once you land on something close, a basic editor lets you tweak fonts, colours, and layout before downloading. What you get in the zip: a standard logo, a transparent background version, a favicon, and pre-sized files for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Twitter, and YouTube. All PNGs. That last part matters, because Hatchful does not export SVG or any vector format. If you later need the logo on a banner, a sign, or embroidered on a jacket, you will have to either recreate it in a vector tool or pay someone to trace it. That limitation tells you who this is actually for. A sole trader testing a business idea, or a Shopify store owner who needs something on the page before launch day, will get through fine. Someone building a brand they plan to use at scale, across print and merchandise and packaging, will eventually hit the wall.

It handles the high-volume, repetitive parts of job searching so users can focus their time on preparing for interviews rather than finding openings.

subtitle: AI job hunter that finds, applies, and follows up for you

description: JobGPT is a fully automated job search assistant that finds openings, tailors your resume to each posting, writes custom cover letters, and submits applications on your behalf. Active job seekers use it to run a high-volume application campaign without the manual effort of customizing materials for each role, with AI handling the personalization that makes applications more likely to pass ATS screening. It works continuously in the background so users wake up to submitted applications rather than spending their evenings job hunting.
name: JobGPT
subtitle: Fully automated AI job search assistant

description: Julius AI is a conversational data analysis tool that connects to spreadsheets, databases, and CSV files and lets you ask questions in plain English — producing charts, statistical summaries, and Python-generated insights without writing code. It can run regression analyses, detect trends, and generate publication-ready visualisations from natural-language instructions. Analysts, marketers, and researchers who work with data but aren't fluent in Python or SQL use Julius to move from raw data to insight in minutes.
name: Julius AI

Because categorization is automatic and mapped directly to Schedule C line items, it reduces the manual work involved in preparing for a tax return or handing data to an accountant.
name: Jupid
subtitle: AI that connects to your bank and categorizes transactions for taxes

description: Khroma is a free AI colour tool that learns your personal colour preferences from a short selection exercise and then generates unlimited palettes, gradients, and colour combinations tailored to your taste. You can browse results as typography, poster, or gradient formats and export swatches directly to your design tools. Designers use it to break out of default colour habits and discover combinations they wouldn't have thought to try manually.

subtitle: AI colour palette generator trained on your preferences

Creators use it to produce voiceovers in their own voice without recording every line, or to create consistent narration for long-form content without multiple recording sessions. The free tier makes it accessible for individual creators who need voice generation but cannot justify a paid subscription for occasional use.

The advisors coordinate context across domains so career advice can factor in financial situation and health goals rather than treating each area in isolation.
name: Kin Personal AI

Users seeking a thoughtful, relationship-oriented AI experience choose Kindroid over more entertainment-focused alternatives.
name: Kindroid

name: Kling AI
